questions.answer: It was close by copenhagen, and i've heard that Lund was a nice city.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: I got send mails everytime I had to take action. So the university was very good at maing sure you did'nt miss any deadlines.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Learn a bit swedish 
2. Try and live near by the center 
3. Join courses for international student, it will be easier to find friends.
